Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
Mr. Shobhit Joshi, learned counsel for 
the petitioner.
2. Mr. Ramesh Chandra Joshi, learned 
Brief Holder for the State/respondent no.1.
3. Mr. Lalit Sharma and Mr. Shailendra 
Nauriyal, learned counsel for respondent 
nos.2 & 3. 
4. Put up this matter on 27.10.2026. 
5. On that day, Commission shall produce 
the documents of the two candidates whose 
names are mentioned at serial no.144 and 234 
since the counsel for the petitioner raise a 
serious doubt on the genuineness of these 
two candidates. Apart from this, the counsel 
for the petitioner submits that the marks of 
the driving test is not uploaded in the 
website and the procedure as adopted for the 
driving test is not transparent and by pick 
and choose method the marks were allotted 
in the driving test. 
6. On the next date, the Commission shall 
produce the entire record of driving test.
7. In the meantime, the selection, if any, 
shall be subject to the outcome of this 
petition. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
